comments.body:
Chunking your study time was what worked best for me. Adding on top of that that the pompodorro method worked wonders and allowed me to be very productive. 25minute study, 5 minute break. Every three cycles (1h30) do a 20min break. Walk around, drink a glass of water.

Put your phone on do not disturb, listen to lyric free music (electro mixes, prog rock, classical) electro mixes really got me in the zone. 

Hang in there! You're gonna be fine. And remember, it's a habit you're forming. It'll get easier with time.
comments.author: big_skapinsky
